assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production game asset: a transparent PNG sprite sheet for an original cozy 16-bit pixel-art top-down laboratory action game, with the disciplined low-resolution craftsmanship of Stardew Valley (original character, not a copied character). EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, evenly spaced square cells in a square image, no grid lines, no text, no labels. Each cell contains the SAME small young lab scientist, full body, brown short hair, teal safety goggles, ivory white lab coat, teal trousers, dark brown shoes, small amber badge. Cute compact proportions, head about one third of height, NOT chibi giant head. Row 1 facing down, 4 walk-cycle frames: idle, left foot, passing, right foot. Row 2 facing left same 4 frames. Row 3 facing right same 4 frames. Row 4 facing up same 4 frames. Constant body size, same centered anchor and foot baseline within each cell, generous transparent gutter, absolutely no objects crossing cells. Character occupies 58 percent of each cell width and 75 percent height. Authentic chunky pixel clusters, about 24 by 32 logical pixels per character enlarged with nearest-neighbor, hard pixel edges, limited 16-color palette, one dark outline, 2-tone shading. NO gradients, NO bloom, NO soft shadows, NO painterly texture, NO glossy 3D, NO background, no checkerboard drawn into image. Real transparent alpha. Hands empty; weapons will be separate game layers. Output just the usable sprite sheet.

Use case: stylized-concept. Create an actual transparent game sprite atlas, original 16-bit hand-crafted pixel art for a top-down laboratory survivor game. Exact 4 columns x 4 rows, equal square cells, square canvas, every object isolated with ample transparent margins, NO borders/grid/labels/text. Retro Stardew Valley-like restricted earthy palette, chunky 1-pixel outlines, discrete 2-tone shadows, all objects coherent scale and light upper-left, no anti-aliased smooth illustration, gradients, glows, photography or 3D. Each sprite occupies at most 70% cell width and height. First row: 4 animation frames of SAME squat brass calibration weight monster with dark feet and tiny angry teal eyes, two-frame waddling loop repeated with slight pose changes. Second row: 4 animation frames of SAME small green rectangular circuit-board beetle monster, visible gold traces, four short jointed legs, amber eyes, alternating walking poses. Third row: 4 animation frames of SAME orange metal coil spring monster with small dark eyes: upright idle, compressed, stretched mid leap, landing. Fourth row isolated inventory/equipped sprites: column1 red fire extinguisher with charcoal hose pointing right; column2 teal and ivory micropipette energy blaster pointing right; column3 small amber glowing pickup crystal made of hard pixels NO halo; column4 small red medical heart pickup. Full real alpha transparency. Characters have same position and scale across each row. Intended for frame-by-frame animation in game, not promotional art. Original designs, simple readable silhouettes, about 24-32 logical pixels wide per sprite enlarged nearest-neighbor.

Use case: stylized-concept. Actual modular environment sprite sheet for an ORIGINAL 16-bit pixel-art top-down science laboratory game. Wide canvas ratio 2:1. EXACT 4 columns and 2 rows equal square cells, isolated objects on real transparent background, each within own cell, no grid lines, no text. Cozy handcrafted pixel art inspired by Stardew Valley interiors, orthographic top-down with a little front face visible, never isometric. Low-resolution chunky pixel clusters, crisp edges, restricted earthy cream, desaturated teal, walnut brown and amber palette, single dark outline, 2-tone shading, no bloom, no gradients, no microtexture. All share consistent light upper-left and same camera. Row1 col1: wide wooden laboratory bench with teal worktop, drawers on front and tiny voltmeter on top. Row1 col2: same bench style with oscilloscope and yellow cable on top. Row1 col3: standing wooden shelf with stacked calibration weights and meter boxes. Row1 col4: tall cream metal equipment locker with teal doors. Row2 col1: wall-mounted dark green chalkboard with tiny abstract circuit marks, absolutely no readable letters. Row2 col2: small potted leafy plant in terracotta pot. Row2 col3: wall-mounted red fire extinguisher cabinet. Row2 col4: squat teal storage crate with amber corner catches. Each cell includes ONLY that prop with generous transparent margin, no floor patch underneath, no background shadow beyond minimal solid pixel contact shadow. Max 82 percent cell width and height. Visually like meticulously placed pixels about 48 by 48 logical pixels per cell enlarged nearest-neighbor. Usable game asset sheet, not a room illustration.
